# Abimael — Portfolio

> Data systems, analytical clarity, and useful automation.

## About
Data Analyst and System Builder focusing on translating raw operational data into repeatable, high-confidence decision workflows.

## Key Projects & Case Studies
- Amazon Product Intelligence: Static-first product intelligence dashboard from 1,465 Amazon catalog and review records.
- ML Product Mapping System: Machine learning matching engine linking supplier descriptions to controlled SKUs.
- Olist E-Commerce Logistics Analysis: Logistics performance and customer satisfaction analysis across ~100k orders using Power BI and statistical modeling.
- Revenue Reconciliation Automation: Modular Python application reconciling multi-source revenue records and anomaly detection.
- Certificate Generator Desktop App: Portable desktop application for batch PDF certificate generation from Excel inputs.
